description: Highly specified 992 GT3 RS with Weissach package, ceramic PCCB brakes, Clubsport equipment, magnesium wheels, front-axle lift and full XPEL PPF. A particularly strong collector-oriented specification with very low mileage.
Near-new 992 GT3 RS with Weissach specification, PCCB ceramics, carbon-focused interior and magnesium wheels. Finished in an exclusive PTS configuration and presented with exceptionally low mileage.
Nearly new Urus SE combining V8 performance with plug-in hybrid technology. A flagship Lamborghini SUV with an exceptionally low 400 km and a luxury-focused specification.

992 GT3 RS built around Porsche's motorsport-derived naturally aspirated 4.0-litre engine. A serious driver’s car with the sought-after GT3 RS character and a well-used but enthusiast-oriented mileage.

Rear-wheel-drive Huracán EVO powered by Lamborghini's naturally aspirated 5.2-litre V10. An engaging, analogue-leaning supercar specification with strong driver focus and unmistakable Italian character.

Ferrari's mid-engine 296 GTB combining a turbocharged V6 with hybrid assistance for exceptional performance. A modern Ferrari with sharp handling, compact proportions and a highly desirable electrified powertrain.

High-performance RS Q8 with a powerful 4.0-litre V8, quattro all-wheel drive and a luxury SUV cabin. Low mileage makes this example particularly attractive for clients wanting supercar pace with everyday practicality.
992-generation 911 GT3 with a naturally aspirated 4.0-litre engine and 510 hp. A purist's specification focused on balance, feedback and everyday usability.
AMG GT R with the twin-turbo 4.0-litre V8 and 585 hp. A focused front-engine performance car with aggressive AMG engineering and strong road-and-track credentials.
First Edition Continental GTC featuring Bentley's 6.0-litre W12 and open-air grand touring character. A rare combination of performance, craftsmanship and luxury.
Luxury performance saloon powered by Bentley's 6.0-litre W12. Designed around effortless high-speed touring, exceptional cabin comfort and discreet performance.
Modern RS6 Avant performance combining a 630 hp V8 with quattro all-wheel drive and everyday estate practicality. A compelling blend of family usability and serious performance.
Cayenne Coupé Turbo GT delivering 640 hp from its 4.0-litre V8. Built for drivers who want Porsche performance with the elevated seating position and versatility of an SUV.
Defender 110 V8 with the 5.0-litre supercharged engine and 525 hp. A distinctive, high-specification luxury off-roader combining heritage-inspired design with modern performance.
V8-powered Defender 110 with Land Rover's 5.0-litre supercharged powertrain. A capable and characterful luxury 4x4 with strong road presence.
Mercedes G 500 combining the classic G-Class silhouette with a powerful petrol V8 and luxury-oriented interior. A timeless and highly recognisable performance SUV.
Front-engine Ferrari GT with a naturally aspirated 6.0-litre V12 producing 620 hp. The 599 GTB Fiorano remains a significant modern-classic Ferrari with strong long-distance character.
High-performance SQ7 with a potent V8, quattro all-wheel drive and a luxury-focused cabin. The example combines strong straight-line performance with practical seven-seat SUV proportions.
Range Rover PHEV combining refined luxury with plug-in hybrid capability and 441 hp. A premium long-distance SUV with a strong balance of comfort, presence and efficiency.
Cayenne Coupé E-Hybrid offering 462 hp through a petrol-electric powertrain. A stylish performance SUV with a strong blend of comfort, efficiency and Porsche dynamics.
Long-wheelbase S 560 with a 470 hp V8 and 4Matic all-wheel drive. Focused on rear-seat comfort, refinement and effortless motorway performance.
Rare M5 Competition Edition with 600 hp and a highly performance-focused character. An executive sedan that delivers classic BMW M performance with everyday practicality.
X5 xDrive45e combining six-cylinder petrol power with plug-in hybrid assistance and executive-level comfort. A versatile premium SUV suited to long-distance and daily use.
Range Rover Velar PHEV with R-Dynamic SE styling and a 400 hp hybrid powertrain. Elegant road presence combined with comfort-oriented premium SUV usability.
Stelvio Quadrifoglio powered by a 2.9-litre twin-turbo V6 producing 510 hp. One of the segment's most characterful performance SUVs, combining Italian styling with sharp driving dynamics.
A6 Avant plug-in hybrid with quattro all-wheel drive and S edition equipment. A polished executive estate offering a strong balance of efficiency, comfort and practicality.
Panigale V4 R presented with an almost delivery-mileage 3 km. A flagship Ducati superbike engineered around extreme performance and track-focused technology.
Panigale V4 SP2 with only 3 km, positioned as a highly collectible track-oriented Ducati. Focused specification and ultra-low mileage make it particularly interesting for enthusiasts and collectors.
Aventador S powered by Lamborghini's naturally aspirated 6.5-litre V12 with 741 hp. A dramatic flagship supercar with the theatre, sound and presence associated with the Aventador name.
